name: Jannah Garden
summary: A flourishing canopy rises over a flowing spring. A garden-inspired identity for hope, renewal, and peaceful devotion.
why: Three broad leaves open above two flowing bands of water. The composition draws on the idea of a garden and a spring to suggest paradise and renewal, without claiming to depict it. Deep green, pale foliage, and warm water give the mark a calm, generous character.
risk: The leaf crown can resemble a lotus, and the garden metaphor can suggest wellness before a prayer app.
